privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.p1: No account, nothing collected. LocalRoll has no servers of its own.
privacy.p2: Photos, videos and files go straight between your own devices on the same network — never through the internet or a cloud.
privacy.p3: Everything sent is encrypted. When pairing, both screens show the same three symbols, so you know it is your own device; after that only that device is trusted.
privacy.p4: No statistics, no ads, no tracking. The app only uses the network to find your devices and send between them.
privacy.p5: The diagnostics log stays on this device and holds no photo contents; it leaves only if you export it.
privacy.p6: Open source (GPL-3.0): anyone can check the code at github.com/lixuedenon/localroll.
privacy.perms: Permissions: Photos — to back up and to save what you receive; Camera — to scan a pairing code and paper documents (on the phone itself); Local network — to find your PC and phones.
